DataHub.GetRandomNumber routes through static DataHub.getrandom System.Random at +0xA74 and calls Random.Next(min,max) under Monitor.Enter/Exit; GameReference.GetRandomNumber independently routes through GameReference.getrandom at +0xC and also calls Random.Next(min,max), with max clamped to 1 when max <= 1

DataHub..cctor @ 0x18B0B30 and GameReference..cctor @ 0x1F7F5D8 allocate System.Random and call the parameterless System.Random..ctor @ 0x047E0BA4; that constructor calls GenerateSeed @ 0x047E0C10 and then Random..ctor(int) @ 0x047E0DFC, so neither field is constructed with a fixed explicit seed

Life.IncrementAgeSimulation @ 0x02575E18..0x0257B1AC calls GameReference.GetRandomNumber directly at 0x0257AB20 and contains NO UnityEngine.Random call; the only UnityEngine call-site is UnityEvent<int>.Invoke (event dispatch). Annual RNG is System.Random, not UnityEngine.Random

System.Random$$Next(int,int) @ 0x047E11D0 executes (int)(Sample() * (double)diff) + minValue with Sample() = InternalSample() * (1.0/MBIG); Sample() is the virtual method at vtable+0xE0, diff is (long)(max-min) converted to double, truncation via vcvt.s32.f64 toward zero, then add minValue. Max is EXCLUSIVE. diff > Int32.MaxValue branches to GetSampleForLargeRange() @ 0x047E1180 (unimplemented, no BitLife call site needs it)

clone/monorandom.py is a Python port of System.Random; clone/fixtures/rng_vectors.json (8 seeds x 14 ops = 112 vectors, generated by clone/gen_fixtures.py) is the shared contract asserted by both clone/test_monorandom.py (23 tests) and web/src/rng-parity.test.ts (26 tests). Constructor must emulate .NET unchecked int32 wrapping on mj/mk and seedArray — Python's unbounded ints otherwise diverge from .NET and from the Int32Array-based TS port for seeds where mk = mj - mk underflows Int32.MinValue (e.g. seed 2147483647)
